DdbEventService.SubscribeStateEvents.cursorReplay: Replays retained events strictly after afterCursor, then continues live without a gap. An unavailable cursor returns DDB_ERROR_CODE_REPLAY_GAP with the retained bounds.
DdbEventService.SubscribeStateEvents.ordering: Events are delivered in monotonically increasing cursor sequence within one server instance. Clients must reject a changed serverInstanceId and resnapshot.
DdbEventService.SubscribeStateEvents.replayLimits: Replay is bounded by the resource limits advertised by GetCapabilities. STATE_EVENT_KIND_REQUIRED_RESYNC requires a fresh snapshot.
DdbEventService.SubscribeStateEvents.backpressure: The state lane is independent of debugger output. Slow consumers are bounded and receive explicit resynchronization instead of silent loss.
DdbEventService.SubscribeStateEvents.lossSignaling: Transport rejection uses DDB_ERROR_CODE_REPLAY_GAP; an established stream uses STATE_EVENT_KIND_REQUIRED_RESYNC when continuity cannot be preserved.

DdbEventService.SubscribeOutput.cursorReplay: Attempts replay strictly after afterCursor only when GetCapabilities advertises output replay. The stream otherwise begins from its documented live boundary.
DdbEventService.SubscribeOutput.ordering: Output envelopes are ordered by the output-lane cursor within one server instance and are intentionally independent of state-event ordering.
DdbEventService.SubscribeOutput.replayLimits: Replay and payload retention are bounded by the output limits advertised by GetCapabilities.
DdbEventService.SubscribeOutput.backpressure: Output cannot delay state delivery. Slow consumers receive explicit OutputGap metadata and may observe bounded/truncated envelopes.
DdbEventService.SubscribeOutput.lossSignaling: OutputEvent.gap identifies the lost cursor interval and reason; OutputEvent.truncated identifies a bounded payload.
